Subject: Unexpected AWS marketplace application fee + missing VAT credit on Oct invoice

We were reconciling the October AWS Marketplace invoice and noticed a new line item labeled 'Application & Service Fee' (3.5%) that we didn't expect — it increased our billed amount by ~USD 4,250. Additionally, the VAT credit I see on the Marketplace portal (EUR 1,200) was not reflected on the pdf invoice attached to this month's charge.

Can you confirm whether Redwood submitted the purchase through the correct listing and whether there was any fee change on your side? We need the corrected invoice (with VAT credit applied) to complete our month-end accounting and to release the remaining payment that is pending.

Attached: AMZ_invoice_202610-ACME.pdf (invoice from AWS portal).

Thanks,

Subject: Request: Clarification and reissued invoice for Acme Analytics (Account: ACME-224) — Oct 2026 charge

Hello AWS Marketplace billing team,

We're assisting our mutual customer, Acme Analytics (Account ACME-224). They queried the October invoice (attached by the customer) — specifically:
- A newly-visible 'Application & Service Fee' line (3.5%) increasing the net charged amount.
- A VAT credit visible in the Marketplace portal for EUR 1,200 that does not appear on the downloadable PDF invoice or final charge record.

Can you confirm: 
1) Whether any fee changes were applied to our product listing effective Oct 1, 2026. (Listing ID: REDWOOD-ML-STD)
2) If the VAT credit is expected to be part of the final invoice or if it's recorded separately in the portal.
3) If possible, please reissue the invoice to include the VAT credit and remove/annotate the application fee if it was applied in error.

Attached: AMZ_invoice_202610-ACME.pdf (from customer).

Please advise an ETA for reissue or any steps we need to complete (PO amendment, DocuSign acceptance, etc.). CC'd the customer to keep them in the loop.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <billing@acmeanalytics.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T07:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Clarification and reissued invoice for Acme Analytics (Account: ACME-224) — Oct 2026 charge

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the details. We investigated and here's what we found: 
1) The listing (REDWOOD-ML-STD) did not have a marketplace application fee change applied on our side for Oct 1. The 3.5% application & service fee line in the attached PDF appears to be a representation of a consolidated fee calculation that included an additional third-party fee (payment processor surcharge) that was applied when the order was fulfilled on Oct 05. We can provide the order-level ledger that shows the surcharge.
2) The VAT credit you see in the portal (EUR 1,200) was issued as a post-invoice adjustment. For certain post-invoice VAT credits, the public PDF isn't automatically regenerated. We can either: 
   a) Reissue a corrected invoice PDF (recommended) that reflects the VAT credit and includes a note line explaining the adjustment, or
   b) Issue a separate credit memo referencing the original invoice (Invoice ID: AMZ-INV-202610-9912).

Next steps we suggest:
- If Redwood/Acme need a single, consolidated PDF for accounting, request reissue and include the preferred language for the VAT line item.
- If Acme prefers a credit memo + original invoice for audit trail, we can issue that and provide the portal entry and ledger export.

We can reissue the invoice within 3 business days after you confirm the desired path. If you'd like us to remove the processor surcharge from the order, we'd need a merchant-of-record review (that may take longer).

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Billing Support
aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com

Attachment stub: AMZ_order_ledger_9912.csv (order ledger, 12 rows)

Subject: Re: Discrepancy on AWS Marketplace invoice: fees + VAT credits

Hi Elena — quick update and proposed path forward.

Thanks for flagging this. AWS has confirmed the VAT credit was posted as a post-invoice adjustment and offered either a reissued invoice (consolidated pdf) or a separate credit memo. They also noted the 3.5% line reflects a payment processor surcharge recorded at fulfillment.

To keep your audit team happy and unblock payment, our recommendation: request a reissued invoice that shows the VAT credit as a distinct line ("VAT post-invoice adjustment - EUR 1,200") and include the order ledger in the attachment for reconciliation. I've attached a short pro forma that maps the portal credit to the invoice lines for your finance team (redwood-proforma-vat-summary.xlsx).

If you confirm that reissue is acceptable, I'll ask AWS to regenerate the PDF and copy you on the reissue email. If your auditors require a credit memo instead, let me know and we'll take that route.

Next steps (proposed):
- Elena: confirm preferred form (reissue PDF vs. credit memo).
- Priya: once confirmed, I will submit the reissue request and follow up with the order ledger and DocuSign if required.
- Marcus/Neha: stand by if AWS requests merchant review to remove processor surcharge.

Thanks,
